armourtypes.name: Chain Hauberk
armourtypes.description: A full-length chain mail coat split from the waist in the front and back to facilitate movement.

armourtypes.name: Chain Shirt
armourtypes.description: A chain mail shirt covering the torso to mid-thigh and half of the upper arms.

armourtypes.name: Chain Shirt & Greaves
armourtypes.description: A chain mail shirt covering the torso to mid-thigh and half of the upper arms, with greaves on the forearms and lower legs.

armourtypes.name: Full Chain
armourtypes.description: Chain mail covering most of the body and legs in the form of a shirt and leggings.

armourtypes.name: Full-Hide Plate
armourtypes.description: Rigid-leather armour that covers the body completely; includes the hide of creatures that contains hard or plentiful rigid plates (e.g., Turtles, Dragons, Giant Crabs).

armourtypes.name: Full Plate
armourtypes.description: Rigid plate armour covering the body, with plates overlapping at joints, and plate armour covering the legs.

armourtypes.name: Half-Hide Plate
armourtypes.description: Rigid-leather armour that covers the body completely; includes the hide of creatures that contain at least a few rigid plates (e.g., Rhinoceros, Alligator).

armourtypes.name: Half Plate
armourtypes.description: Rigid plate armour covering the body, but with chain mail between the plates, at the joints, and covering the legs.

armourtypes.name: Heavy Hide
armourtypes.description: The natural hide of certain animals (e.g., Buffalo, Elephant, Bear).

armourtypes.name: Leather Breastplate
armourtypes.description: A rigid breastplate covering the torso to mid-thigh and part of the upper arms.

armourtypes.name: Leather Breastplate & Greaves
armourtypes.description: A rigid breastplate covering the torso to mid-thigh and part of the upper arms, with leather greaves covering the forearms and lower legs.

armourtypes.name: Leather Coat
armourtypes.description: A heavy leather coat covering the arms and torso to mid-thigh, normally worn only for protection against the weather.

armourtypes.name: Leather Jerkin
armourtypes.description: A heavy leather coat without arms and reaching only to the waist or mid-thigh, normally worn only for protection against the weather.

armourtypes.name: Light Hide
armourtypes.description: The natural hide of certain animals (e.g., Deer, Dog, Wolf).

armourtypes.name: Metal Breastplate
armourtypes.description: A metal breastplate plus smaller plates covering torso to mid-thigh and part of the upper arms.

armourtypes.name: Metal Breastplate & Greaves
armourtypes.description: A metal breastplate plus smaller plates covering torso to mid-thigh and part of the upper arms, with greaves on the forearms and lower legs.

armourtypes.name: Reinforced Full-Length Leather Coat
armourtypes.description: A heavy leather coat covering the arms and torso to the lower leg, with either rigid leather sections or metal sections sewn in for reinforcement.

armourtypes.name: Reinforced Leather Coat
armourtypes.description: A heavy leather coat covering the arms and torso to mid-thigh, with either rigid leather sections or metal sections sewn in for reinforcement.

armourtypes.name: Robes
armourtypes.description: Full-length robes normally worn by spell users and certain other combatants.

armourtypes.name: Skin
armourtypes.description: Normal clothing, assumed if other covering is not specified.
